source: The New Mordheimer scenario compendium (MordheimerData/Sourcedata scenarios.json). App-tracked Experience awards folded in from scenarios.json where the names match.

entries.title: Defend the Find
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1 · Setting: Mordheim)

Defend a building from attackers.

Experience:
+1 — Winning Leader (The leader of the winning warband.)
+1 — Per Enemy Out of Action (Any Hero, for each enemy he puts out of action.)
+1 — Survives (applies to every scenario)

entries.title: Skirmish
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1 · Setting: Mordheim)

Brawl between rival warbands.

Experience:
+1 — Winning Leader (The leader of the winning warband.)
+1 — Per Enemy Out of Action (Any Hero, for each enemy he puts out of action.)
+1 — Survives (applies to every scenario)

entries.title: Wyrdstone Hunt
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1 · Setting: Mordheim)

Gain wealth by picking up wyrdstone.

Experience:
+1 — Winning Leader (The leader of the winning warband.)
+1 — Per Wyrdstone Counter (If carrying a Wyrdstone counter at the end of the battle.)
+1 — Per Enemy Out of Action (Any Hero, for each enemy he puts out of action.)
+1 — Survives (applies to every scenario)

entries.title: Breakthrough
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1 · Setting: Mordheim)

The attacker needs to reach the other side of the board.

Experience:
+1 — Winning Leader (The leader of the winning warband.)
+1 — Per Enemy Out of Action (Any Hero, for each enemy he puts out of action.)
+1 — Breaking Through (Any warrior for breaking through enemy lines (whole group if a Henchman).)
+1 — Survives (applies to every scenario)

entries.title: Street Fight
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1 · Setting: Mordheim)

Both warbands try to reach the other side of the street.

Experience:
+1 — Winning Leader (The leader of the winning warband.)
+1 — Per Enemy Out of Action (Any Hero, for each enemy he puts out of action.)
+1 — Escaping (The first Hero from either side (not both) who exits via the opposing table edge.)
+1 — Survives (applies to every scenario)

entries.title: Chance Encounter
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1 · Setting: Mordheim)

Two warbands try to steal each other's wyrdstone.

Experience:
+1 — Winning Leader (The leader of the winning warband.)
+1 — Per Enemy Out of Action (Any Hero, for each enemy he puts out of action.)
+1 — Survives (applies to every scenario)

entries.title: Hidden Treasure
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1 · Setting: Mordheim)

Search the buildings for a hidden treasure.

Experience:
+1 — Winning Leader (The leader of the winning warband.)
+1 — Per Enemy Out of Action (Any Hero, for each enemy he puts out of action.)
+2 — Finding the Chest (The Hero who finds the treasure chest.)
+1 — Survives (applies to every scenario)

entries.title: Occupy
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1 · Setting: Mordheim)

Both warbands try to capture as many buildings as they can.

Experience:
+1 — Winning Leader (The leader of the warband controlling the most buildings at the end (no bonus if tied).)
+1 — Per Enemy Out of Action (Any Hero, for each enemy he puts out of action.)
+1 — Survives (applies to every scenario)

entries.title: Surprise Attack
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1 · Setting: Mordheim)

The Defender tries to fend off the attacker and starts with limited numbers.

Experience:
+1 — Winning Leader (The leader of the winning warband.)
+1 — Per Enemy Out of Action (A Hero, for each enemy he puts out of action.)
+1 — Survives (applies to every scenario)

Multiplayer. Similar to Wyrdstone Hunt.

Multiplayer. Similar to Skirmish.

entries.title: The Lost Prince
entries.body:
(Players: Multiplayer · Setting: Mordheim)

The warbands have heard rumours that a powerful man's son has wandered into the ruins and a handsome reward will be paid for his return.

entries.title: The Wizard's Mansion
entries.body:
(Players: Multiplayer · Setting: Mordheim)

Multiplayer. Similar to Skirmish with items at stake.

(Players: Multiplayer · Setting: Mordheim)

Multiplayer. Root around for Wyrdstone in a pool in the centre of the table.

entries.title: Ambush!
entries.body:
(Players: Multiplayer · Setting: Mordheim)

Multiplayer. Wyrdstone carrying defenders have to get off the table alive.

entries.title: Monster Hunt
entries.body:
(Players: Multiplayer · Setting: Mordheim)

Multiplayer. Warbands team up (or not) to take on a monster.

entries.title: Kidnapped
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1 · Setting: Mordheim)

Possessed vs. any warband. Rescue a fair maiden before she gets sacrificed or sacrifice a fair maiden before she gets rescued, depending on your mood.

entries.title: Rat Attack
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1 · Setting: Mordheim)

Skaven vs. any warband. Sewers. Defender must escape from opposite table edge. Skaven uses a mixture of decoy counters and warband counters to confuse the enemy.

entries.title: Scourge & Purge
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1 · Setting: Mordheim)

Witch Hunters vs. any warband. Skirmish in the company of a possessed wizard.

entries.title: Surrounded
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1 · Setting: Mordheim)

Sewers. Defender must escape from centre of sewer network.

entries.title: Forbidden Square
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1,Multiplayer · Setting: Mordheim)

A Witch Hunter Warband has been sent into a specific part of the City of the Damned by prominent members of the Order of the Templars of Sigmar.

entries.title: Stake-Out
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1 · Setting: Mordheim)

Sneaky attackers must kill the leader of the startled defenders. Defenders' leader must escape from table.

entries.title: The Lair of the Snake
entries.body:
(Players: Multiplayer · Setting: Mordheim)

Four player scenario. Each player must take out his randomly specified enemy.

entries.title: The Script of Sigmar
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1 · Setting: Mordheim)

Witch Hunters vs. Sisters of Sigmar. Two linked scenarios involving burgling the Sisters' Abbey.

entries.title: That's All Mine
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1 · Setting: Mordheim)

Attackers blow up a mine using gunpowder rules from Archive Pestilens (shamefully not described in the magazine) amid some random zombie shenanigans.

entries.title: The Caravan
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1 · Setting: Mordheim)

Escort or rob a merchant's caravan train.

entries.title: The Secrets of Beujuntae
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1,Multiplayer · Setting: Lustria)

Wyrdstone Hunt while a Daemon spirit flits around possessing random Heroes.

entries.title: Jungle Skirmish / The Fog of War
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1,Multiplayer · Setting: Lustria)

Light fog affecting movement and missile range.

entries.title: Island Hopping
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1,Multiplayer · Setting: Lustria)

Islands in a fast flowing river connected by bridges. Control as many as possible.

entries.title: The Night Of The Headless One
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1,Multiplayer · Setting: Mordheim)

Hidden Treasure except warbands look for skull of the Headless One while its awesome original owner creates carnage.

entries.title: The Hunters Become The Hunted
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1,Multiplayer · Setting: Lustria)

Similar to Surprise Attack.

entries.title: Lost Temple Of The Slann
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1,Multiplayer · Setting: Lustria)

Similar to Wizard's Mansion.

entries.title: The Sword of the Herald
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1,Multiplayer · Setting: Mordheim)

Multiplayer scenario involving a mean sword, huge chunks of Wyrdstone & those ever-popular random zombies.

entries.title: Finders Keepers
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1 · Setting: Mordheim)

Run the length of the table, grab the Wyrdstone & run back again while trying not to die. Designed for mounted warriors but doesn't have to be.

entries.title: Mule Train
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1 · Setting: Mordheim)

The good guys try to lead the mule train along a country road while the bad guys try to steal them.

entries.title: Death in the Mists
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1 · Setting: Albion)

Visibility reduced to 2D6". Warriors might get lost.

entries.title: Gift of the Truthsayers
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1 · Setting: Albion)

Scrap over a magic item with random boggy happenings.

entries.title: The Mummy
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1,Multiplayer · Setting: Mordheim)

Hidden Treasure except warbands look for the stash of a mummy while its scary original owner plus friends have their say.

entries.title: The Ogham Stones
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1 · Setting: Albion)

Enhance powers for spell-casters with Truthsayers & Dark Emissaries tagging along for good measure.

entries.title: Haunted Treasure
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1 · Setting: Mordheim)

Serious treasure guarded by equally serious Banshee.

entries.title: A Night In The Graveyard
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1,Multiplayer · Setting: Mordheim)

Warbands compete to plunder a dead man's grave while his restless spirit attempts to stop them.

entries.title: Bar Room Brawl
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1,Multiplayer · Setting: Mordheim)

A bar room brawl. Players start with 3 warriors in bar with more arriving during battle.

entries.title: Defend the Oasis
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1 · Setting: Khemri)

Attackers must get more men within 6" of a well than the defenders. Defenders must cause a rout test.

entries.title: Tomb Raid
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1,Multiplayer · Setting: Khemri)

As Defend The Tomb except the chest begins in the middle of the complex while both warbands begin at the edges.

entries.title: Protect the Prince
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1,Multiplayer · Setting: Khemri)

Protect the Merchant's son.

entries.title: Burn the Witches
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1 · Setting: Mordheim)

Set in a huge temple which burns to the ground during the battle. Defender's Heroes must carry three relics from the temple. Attackers must stop them.

entries.title: One Man's Rescue is Another Man's Kidnap
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1 · Setting: Khemri)

A prisoner is being guarded within one of several tents. The attacker must find the prisoner by entering the correct tent and then escort him from the table.

entries.title: The Gauntlet
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1,Multiplayer · Setting: Mordheim)

Classic Indiana Jones stuff. Warbands race along trap-laden corridors towards a great treasure. For 2+ warbands.

entries.title: Assault on the Rock
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1,Multiplayer · Setting: Mordheim)

Warbands infiltrate the Sisters' rock and attempt to steal a magical tome.

entries.title: In The Dead Of The Night
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1 · Setting: Mordheim)

Set in Mordheim's Cemetery of Saint Voller. Graveyard battle with Undead warband, half is which is unavailable, as the defenders.

entries.title: A Stroll In The Garden
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1,Multiplayer · Setting: Mordheim)

Skirmish set in Mordheim's Steinhardt Memorial Gardens. Warriors within 2â€ of a tree or bush receive hits from the chaos-wracked foliage.

entries.title: The Bodyguards
entries.body:
(Players: Multiplayer · Setting: Mordheim)

Town Cryer edit of "Now Keep Me Safe, You Hear!?"

entries.title: Blood Hunt
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1,Multiplayer · Setting: Mordheim)

Clashing warbands gain the help of a Dramatis Personae, most likely Johann The Knife & Marriana Chevaux, free of charge.

entries.title: Bounty Hunting
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1,Multiplayer · Setting: The Empire)

An Empire In Flames scenario. Warbands attempt to round up a gang of bandits who are holed up in a remote hideout building.

entries.title: Down At The Docks
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1,Multiplayer · Setting: Mordheim)

Warbands must attempt to gain cargo crates from smugglers' ship by carrying them off.

entries.title: Lost In The Bogs
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1,Multiplayer · Setting: The Empire)

An Empire In Flames scenario. Highest rated warband is lost & must be deployed spread out.

entries.title: Stagecoash Ambush
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1 · Setting: The Empire)

An Empire In Flames scenario. Defenders on horseback must protect a stagecoach from mounted attackers.

entries.title: The Item Lost
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1,Multiplayer · Setting: Mordheim)

Nicodemus joins one warband in an attempt to retrieve a magic wand. Naturally the other warbands would like the wand for themselves.

entries.title: The Thing In The Woods
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1,Multiplayer · Setting: The Empire)

An Empire In Flames scenario. At least 1/2 the terrain is spooky fear-inducing woods.

entries.title: Gathering of the Horde
entries.body:
(Players: Multiplayer · Setting: Mordheim)

Massive multi-warband gang fight based upon the â€œGangs Of New Yorkâ€ film, complete with special rules for horde fighting.

entries.title: The Watchers
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1,Multiplayer · Setting: Mordheim)

Warbands attempt to gather random treasures from the SE quarter of Mordheim (right next to where the comet landed).

entries.title: The Frenzied Mob
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1,Multiplayer · Setting: The Empire)

An Empire In Flames scenario. Warbands attempt to loot a village consisting of D3+1 buildings. Each building is staunchly defended by D3+1 frenzied villagers.

entries.title: Encampment Raid
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1 · Setting: The Empire)

Attackers attempt to take the defenders' camp. Plays as Defend The Find except the defenders have a number of advantages due to being on home turf.

entries.title: The Rat's Lair
entries.body:
(Players: Multiplayer #28 · Setting: Mordheim)

Designed for several warbands to ally against a pack of Skaven run by a moderator. The warbands descend into an ingenious multi-leveled underground lair.

entries.title: Upon the Eerie Downs
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1,Multiplayer · Setting: The Empire)

A sombre and mysterious place, the Eerie Downs holds a palpable dread for the folk of the Mark.

entries.title: Battle for the Farm
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1,Multiplayer · Setting: The Empire)

There are many farmsteads around Ostermark. Mercenaries and brigands are drawn to them like moths to the flame as.

entries.title: Blood on the Pasturelands
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1,Multiplayer · Setting: The Empire)

Rival warbands attempt to rustle some horses from a pasture. The frightened horses run randomly and need taming once caught. They are defended by six Outriders.

entries.title: Through Black Fire Pass
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1 · Setting: The Empire)

One warband ambushes another as they make their way along the treacherous trade route.

entries.title: Brigands in the Pasturelands
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1 · Setting: The Empire)

One warband attempts to hunt down the other, a lawless band of brigands hiding out In the forest.

entries.title: The Watchtower
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1 · Setting: The Empire)

Half of the defending warband starts on or near a well-defended central tower (with special rules to reflect this).

entries.title: Wolf Hunt!
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1,Multiplayer · Setting: The Empire)

Both warbands have been offered a reward to kill a pack of troublesome wolves.

entries.title: Protect Hornsby's Ferry!
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1,Multiplayer · Setting: The Empire)

Defenders must protect a boat & pull-rope style river ferry-crossing from sabotage. Attackers must sabotage it.

entries.title: Stop Thief!
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1,Multiplayer · Setting: The Empire)

Defenders must protect Halfling Thief HS (featured In this issue) from attacking warband.

entries.title: Hunt the Heretic
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1 · Setting: The Empire)

Four members of the defenders' warband attempt to protect a tooled-up Warlock HS from the attackers plus an accompanying Witch Hunter Captain.

entries.title: River Watch
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1 · Setting: The Empire)

Attackers at the south side must smuggle some loot across a east-west flowing river at night and get 25% of their band off the north edge.

entries.title: Night Of The Dead
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1,Multiplayer · Setting: Mordheim)

Warband members must venture to the centre of the board, grab a Wyrdstone shard and escape from the table.

entries.title: Happy Harpy Hunting Grounds
entries.body:
(Players: Multiplayer · Setting: Mordheim)

A group of 3 Harpies have nested in one of the tall buildings and their scavenging and attacks on unfortunate warbands has ensured a sizable stash of valuables.

entries.title: Round-up at the Mordheim Corral
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1,Multiplayer · Setting: Mordheim)

Two to four wild boars have eaten a merchant's Wyrdstone. Warbands must kill randomly moving and aggressive boars to recover it. Optional suggestion of using mutations.

entries.title: The Recipe
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1,Multiplayer · Setting: Mordheim)

Warbands must attempt to abduct an esteemed pie-maker who is being stoutly defended by his ballistically adept bodyguard.

entries.title: Defend the Village!
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1 · Setting: The Empire)

The Magnificent Seven without the cowboy hats.

entries.title: Don't Wake the Giant
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1,Multiplayer · Setting: Mordheim)

Two warbands fight for the giant's goodies while trying not to wake him.

entries.title: Grudge Match
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1 · Setting: Mordheim)

Honorable duel between two rival heroes, watched by their warbands and with a serious chance of crowd trouble breaking out.

entries.title: It's all MINE!!
entries.body:
(Players: 1v1 · Setting: Mordheim)

Attackers blow up a mine using gunpowder rules from Archive Pestilens (shamefully not described in the magazine) amid some random zombie shenanigans.

Attack on warband's camp. Defender in centre, attacker on edges.

Bad warband vs. townsfolk; Raid a village for loot & slaves.

Get a wagon train across the board using wagon rules from Wyrdstone Archive while your opponent tries to stop you.

entries.title: Rescue

(Players: 1v1 · Setting: Mordheim)

Rescue captive warrior. Defender in centre, attacker on edges.

entries.body:
(Players: 1v1 · Setting: Mordheim)

A variation on the random zombie invasion theme.

None

Skirmish over a keep.

Random zombies invade the table, attacking both players.

Four player scenario. Each player must take out his randomly specified enemy.

entries.title: The Wizard's Tower
entries.body:
(Players: Multiplayer · Setting: Mordheim)

Your warband is peacefully making their way through the city to a Wyrdstone deposit when they are set upon be a rival warband. They have no choice but to fight their way through them to get to the Wyrdstone.

entries.title: Mordheim's Burning
entries.body:
(Players: Multiplayer · Setting: Mordheim)

This scenario is set at the end of Mordheim's existence, and provides a very fitting ending to a campaign.
